name: Deep-Scar Ravine
introDiscord:
A trench-wide scar cuts across the seabed.

Whatever created it did not strike the Leviathan.

The Leviathan created the scar.
introTwitch:
A trench-wide scar cuts across the seabed.

Whatever created it did not strike the Leviathan.

The Leviathan created the scar.

deep-scar-ravine-approach.prompt: Three paths descend into the groove carved through solid stone.

left.message:
A calm mineral spring rests behind a broken rib.

Shizuki wrote:

'This scar was made by ONE creature moving across ground.

I would like everyone to appreciate how upsetting that sentence is.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the spring untouched and appreciate it appropriately.

right.message: A Deep-Scar Prowler emerges from a groove inside the larger scar.

forward.message: A navigator's chest sits where centuries of current deposited it.

left.message:
One Berry rests beside Shizuki's measurement marker:

'Scar width:
too wide.

Scar depth:
also too.

Research complete.'

right.message: A wrecked strongbox lies inside a crack.

forward.message:
A Prowler races along the ancient groove as if following a trail left
yesterday.

deep-scar-ravine-threshold.prompt: Ancient Wound opens where the scar becomes deepest.

left.message: A Deep-Scar Prowler watches from inside the Leviathan-made trench.

right.message:
Shizuki's bottle reads:

'Rest before entering giant mystery gouge.

Good life advice generally.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the bottle and adopt the advice.

forward.message: Star Candies rest inside stone fractured by the ancient passage.

boss-antechamber.name: Ancient Wound
boss-antechamber.prompt: The deepest portion of Ancient Wound goes silent.

bossPromptDiscord:
The deepest portion of Ancient Wound goes silent.

Long claw marks cover the stone.

A predator steps from one of them as if the scar itself has been hiding
it.

Use /yes to enter Ancient Wound or /no to stop investigating ancient
things with claw marks.
bossPromptTwitch:
The deepest portion of Ancient Wound goes silent.

Long claw marks cover the stone.

A predator steps from one of them as if the scar itself has been hiding
it.

Use !yes to enter Ancient Wound or !no to stop investigating ancient
things with claw marks.
bossRetreatText: You climb out of the scar.

boss.revealText:
A massive scar-covered predator emerges.

Scar-Marked Huntmaster reveals itself!

completionText:
The Huntmaster disappears along the ancient groove.

Whatever Leviathan originally made this wound was larger than anything
you've fought here.

By an uncomfortable margin.
